note: Hand-labeled queries over the fixture library in internal/search/testdata/corpus-v1.json. Gains: 3 is what the user meant, 2 is a good alternative, 1 is related. A query with an empty `relevant` has no right answer and is judged only on coming back empty. Keyed by reel URL, so this set only measures a library that actually holds these reels: seed the corpus into a dedicated evaluation user, or write a set labeled with a real user's own reel URLs. Add queries by appending; changing an existing judgment means a new version, because reports are only comparable within one version. The intent line names the arm each query is meant to lean on: full-text reaches title, summary and caption, trigram reaches the title, and the vector arm is the only one that reaches tags, key facts, places and category.
